"""Check all quality stream bindings and separately recompute the saved native arrays."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from balanced_spatial_metrics import DetailMetrics
from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V172-local-noise-matching-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);normalization=read(root/'method-label-normalization-v2.json');assert ref(normalization['normalized']['path'])==normalization['normalized'];scores=read(root/'scores-method-labels-v2.json');design=read(plan['design']['path'])['observations'];prior=read(plan['prior_scores']['path'])
baseline=read(plan['baseline_scores']['path']);assert ref(plan['baseline_scores']['path'])==plan['baseline_scores']
baseline_plan=read(baseline['plan']['path']);assert baseline_plan['design']==plan['design'] and baseline_plan['metrics_sources']==plan['metrics_sources']
assert len([r for r in baseline['rows'] if r['method']=='V171-EMA'])==822
oldrows={r['id']:r for r in prior['rows'] if r['method']=='balanced-EMA'}
events=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'forward-events-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
journal=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'observations-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(events)==len(journal)==1644 and scores['counts']==plan['expected_quality_counts']
assert scores['weights_unchanged'] and scores['RNG_unchanged'] and scores['exact_V169_replays']==1644
assert scores['ADC_outputs_exact_V169']==144
metric=DetailMetrics(plan['metrics_sources']);rows={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in scores['rows']}
counts=dict(wrapper=0,frozen=0,network=0,sampler=0)
inputs=scalars=predictions=corrections=additions=ADC=0
for offset,endpoint in enumerate(['raw','EMA']):
 for ordinal,index in enumerate(plan['processing_order']):
  case=design[index];event=events[offset*822+ordinal];record=journal[offset*822+ordinal];method=f'V172-{endpoint}';row=rows[case['id'],method]
  assert event['endpoint']==record['endpoint']==endpoint and event['index']==record['index']==index
  assert event['id']==record['id']==case['id'] and event['ordinal']==ordinal
  assert dict(record['row'],method=record['row']['method'].replace('V171-','V172-',1))==row and record['arrays']==case['arrays'] and record['parent']==case['parent']
  assert ref(case['arrays']['path'])==case['arrays'] and ref(case['parent']['path'])==case['parent']
  a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));base=np.load(case['parent']['path']);noisy=bool(np.any(a['variance']>0))
  for k,value in record['inputs'].items():assert fingerprint(a[k])==value;inputs+=1
  assert event['matching_evaluated']==noisy and row['ADC_exact']==(not noisy)
  counts['wrapper']+=1;counts['frozen']+=1;counts['network']+=int(noisy);counts['sampler']+=5*int(noisy)
  assert event['counts']==counts
  assert record['frozen_replay_exact'] and record['closure_exact'] and row['frozen_replay_exact']
  assert row['frozen_values']==oldrows[case['id']]['values']
  if not noisy:assert row['values']==row['frozen_values'];ADC+=1
  if case['id'] not in scores['native_predictions']:continue
  bindings=scores['native_predictions'][case['id']]
  b=bindings[method];assert ref(b['path'])==b;value=np.load(b['path']);assert fingerprint(value)==row['values'];predictions+=1
  b=bindings[method+'-correction'];assert ref(b['path'])==b;correction=np.load(b['path']);assert fingerprint(correction)==row['nonlocal_correction_values'];corrections+=1
  b=prior['native_predictions'][case['id']]['balanced-EMA'];assert ref(b['path'])==b;frozen=np.load(b['path']);assert fingerprint(frozen)==row['frozen_values']
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(value,frozen+correction);additions+=value.size
  actual=metric.measure(case,a,base,value)
  for field,v in actual.items():
   if isinstance(v,(float,int)) and not isinstance(v,bool):assert abs(v-row[field])<1e-10;scalars+=1
  expected=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(correction.astype(np.float64)**2)))*65535
  assert abs(expected-row['nonlocal_correction_RMS_DN16'])<1e-10;scalars+=1
assert inputs==6576 and predictions==corrections==72 and counts==plan['expected_quality_counts'] and ADC==144
training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');assert ref(training['final_checkpoint']['path'])==training['final_checkpoint']
state=torch.load(training['final_checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
module=LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**plan['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(state['models'],strict=True)
assert model_hash(module)==scores['module_hashes']['raw']['before']==scores['module_hashes']['raw']['after']
module.network.load_state_dict(state['ema'],strict=True)
assert model_hash(module)==scores['module_hashes']['EMA']['before']==scores['module_hashes']['EMA']['after']
assert model_hash(module.frozen)==plan['frozen_component']['module_hash'] and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(root/'quality-audit-v1.json',dict(status='pass-all-stream-bindings-and-selected-native-outputs-and-residuals',plan=ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),scores=ref(root/'scores-method-labels-v2.json'),
 actual_wrapper_events=1644,frozen_component_calls=1644,new_matching_calls=1500,nested_quality_sampling_calls=7500,input_fingerprints_checked=inputs,exact_V169_replay_bindings=1644,ADC_outputs_exact_V169=ADC,
 saved_native_RGB_checked=predictions,saved_native_residuals_checked=corrections,scalar_checks=scalars,independent_native_addition_channels=additions,allcase_inprocess_addition_channels=scores['independent_inprocess_addition_channels'],strict_endpoint_state_loads=2,
 forward_journal=ref(root/'forward-events-v1.jsonl'),observation_journal=ref(root/'observations-v1.jsonl'),new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
 scope='All1644 actual composition event/input/parent/V169 replay bindings,6576 actual input fingerprints and1644 method rows match durable journals. All144 ADC outputs retain V169 exactly. Independent posthoc metrics/FP32 residual-addition checks cover36 preselected native cases at both endpoints,72 RGB+72 residual arrays. Other new outputs were scored/fingerprinted and independently norm/decomposition/addition checked in process but not retained;there is no full new-array posthoc audit.'))
print('PASS1644 events/V169 replays;6576 input fingerprints;72 RGB+72 residual arrays;',scalars,'scalars')
